name: Triad — Epoch‑Ignition Wave Geometry
summary: Defines the geometry of epoch‑ignition waves, including ignition‑epoch wave formation, ignition‑epoch propagation geometry, ignition‑epoch stabilization routes, and multi‑layer ignition‑epoch binding behavior.
